author: Natalie Wong, Laura Nahmias
description: Just two months ago, Vornado Realty Trust was boasting about financial behemoth Citadel’s appetite for New York real estate, vowing to create a new icon for the Manhattan skyline.
title: Citadel Sends Warning Shot to NYC After Mamdani Blasts Billionaire Griffin

author: Catherine Lucey
description: President Donald Trump said he would look into the actions of banks in their response to last year’s devastating Los Angeles wildfires following a meeting with that city’s mayor, Karen Bass.
title: Trump Says He’ll Probe Banks Over Response to LA Wildfires

author: Patricia Hurtado
description: A US Army soldier was charged with using classified information about the timing of the US military’s capture of then-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro to make more than $400,000 trading on Polymarket’s prediction market, the Justice Department said Thursday.
title: US Soldier Charged With Using Classified Data to Bet on Maduro

description: John Bolton, former US National Security Advisor and former US Ambassador to the United Nations, argues the US should take the time necessary to overthrow the regime in Iran. He says the damage to Iran's military and nuclear infrastructure is significant, but urges continued pressure to induce regime collapse, adding the President's original 4-6 week timeline "was never realistic." He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Needs 'Patience' in Iran: John Bolton

description: President Donald Trump says the administration is considering a financial rescue package or possibly buying Spirit Airlines during remarks to reporters in the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says He's Considering Having the US Buy Spirit Airlines

description: Representative Raja Krishnamoorthi (D-IL), a member of the House Oversight and Intelligence Committees, calls the conflict with Iran a "colossal disaster," warning Tehran now has a "chokehold" on global energy via the Strait of Hormuz. He argues the war is driving up costs for Americans - from gasoline to groceries - while hurting farmers and depleting US munitions stockpiles, and says the conflict should be ended immediately through diplomacy. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Rep. Krishnamoorthi: Iran War a 'Colossal Disaster'

author: Catherine Lucey
description: President Donald Trump said he would investigate federal employees placing bets on event-betting platforms, indicating concerns with prediction markets amid worries that individuals are using confidential government information to profit.
title: Trump Says He’ll Look Into Federal Worker Prediction Market Bets

author: Catherine Lucey
description: US President Donald Trump said he didn’t expect Vladimir Putin to attend the Group of 20 meeting at his resort in Doral, Florida, later this year, but said the Russian leader’s participation could be useful.
title: Trump Says Putin G-20 Visit Would ‘Probably Be Very Helpful’

description: President Donald Trump said Israel and Lebanon will extend their ceasefire by three weeks to work on a long-term deal during remarks to reporters at the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says Israel-Lebanon Ceasefire Extended Three Weeks

author: Allyson Versprille, Catherine Lucey
description: President Donald Trump said he is considering having the US purchase Spirit Aviation Holdings Inc., saying it could be a potentially good investment for the federal government.
title: Trump Says the US Is Weighing Purchase of Spirit Airlines

author: Martha Viotti Beck, Dayanne Sousa, Beatriz Reis, Barbara Nascimento
description: Brazil’s government will ask Congress for authorization to use extraordinary revenue linked to oil to cut taxes on fuel such as gasoline, diesel, ethanol and biodiesel.
title: Brazil Seeks New Measures to Tame War Impact on Fuels

description: Senator Bill Hagerty (R-TN), a member of the Senate Foreign Relations and Banking Committees, says President Trump "has all the cards" in Iran negotiations and warns Tehran's oil storage constraints could become a near-term breaking point. Hagerty also backs Kevin Warsh as Fed chair amid confirmation uncertainty, urging Democrats to advance his nomination, and expresses optimism on budget negotiations while warning DHS funding lapses could heighten security risks. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Sen. Hagerty on Iran, Budget Talks

author: James Mayger
description: Japan and Australia are set to add to their close and burgeoning defense relationship, with the two nations set to seal an economic security deal in early May, Kyodo News reported.
title: Japan, Australia to Tighten Ties With Economic Deal, Kyodo Says

author: Nick Wadhams
description: Israel and Lebanon will extend their ceasefire by three weeks, US President Donald Trump said in a social media post.
title: Trump Says Israel and Lebanon to Extend Ceasefire by Three Weeks

description: President Trump told reporters he would not use a nuclear weapon against Iran and once again said that he doesn't see conflict with Iran lasting much longer as he took questions at an Oval Office event on drug pricing. Trump told reporters that rising gas prices are not as high as he expected, but warned that Americans will be paying more for gas for a 'little while.' The president also commented on the ousting of Navy Secretary James Phelan, saying that conflicts emerged about shipbuilding. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says US Wouldn’t Use Nuclear Weapon Against Iran: Q&A

author: Denitsa Tsekova, Nicola M White, Lydia Beyoud
description: In the oil market, volatility recently spiked to levels not seen since the onset of the Covid-19 pandemic. Commodities and stocks globally have whipsawed in response to every twist and turn in the Iran war: A strike, a pause, a threat to wipe out a civilization, a ceasefire; then a deal, no deal, and the prospect of one again.
title: Trump’s Iran Pivots Spotlight Washington’s Insider Trade Threat

description: President Donald Trump says the US is in total control of the Strait of Hormuz during a health-care affordability event at the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says Higher Gas Prices Will Remain 'For a Little While'

author: Nancy Cook
description: The president is backing opponents of two Republican incumbents in primaries.
title: Two Primaries to Test Trump’s Grip on Republican Politics

description: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec speak with Bloomberg Tech Co-Host Ed Ludlow about Meta and Microsoft looking to trim their workforces amid heavy AI spending. Then, Lombard Odier Investment Head of Macro Florian Ielpo weighs in on markets as oil climbs amid a continued Iran ceasfire, and stocks waver near record highs. Then, Curaleaf CEO Boris Jordan weighs in on cannabis markets amid new US legislation. Plus, ob Sulentic, CBRE Group Chairman & CEO, joins Bloomberg TV Markets Correspondent Norah Mulinda for a conversation about earnings, data center real estate, and the current real estate backdrop in New York City. Finally, Dr. Doug Lucas, LifeMD Bone Health & Longevity Clinical Lead, speaks about women’s bone health. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Meta, Microsoft to Trim Workforces Amid AI Spending | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 4/23/2026

description: The European Union warned member states that efforts to strengthen safeguards in the bloc’s trade agreement with the US may cause the deal to unravel.
title: EU Warns Trade Deal With US at Risk Over Effort to Strengthen It

description: President Donald Trump’s order for the US to attack Iranian gunboats is the latest sign that an asymmetrical war-fighting strategy is stymieing the world’s mightiest navy, with US aircraft and destroyers forced to track swarming speedboats in a vital energy waterway.
title: Trump Attack Order Highlights Danger of Iran’s ‘Mosquito Fleet’

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power,  Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss President Trump's order to strike boats laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz as the tennuous ceasefire between the US and Iran continues without peace talks and news that Meta plans to cut 10% of its workforce. On today's show, former Deputy Commander of U.S. Central Command Vice Admiral Robert Harward (ret.), Republican Main Street Partnership President and CEO Sarah Chamberlain, former White House Deputy Chief of Staff under President Barack Obama Jim Messina, Bloomberg Economics Chief Geoeconomics Analyst Jennifer Welch, and Democrat Senator from Illinois Tammy Duckworth. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US-Iran Tensions Build in Hormuz Without Talks | Balance of Power: Early Edition 4/23/2026

description: Modi’s government tried to change the makeup of India ’s Parliament. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Andy Mukherjee explains what’s at stake. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Why Modi Tried to Change India’s Parliament

author: Ania Nussbaum
description: Emmanuel Macron has given few hints about his plan once he leaves the French presidency next year. But sitting among schoolchildren in Cyprus, he signaled it may not involve politics.
title: Macron Offers a Glimpse of a Post-Presidency Outside Politics

description:
Sen. Tammy Duckworth (D-IL), member of the Armed Services Committee, said that the war with Iran is President Trump's 'war of choice' and at the expense of the American people. 
US and Iran tensions grew over the Strait of Hormuz with both sides maintaining their blockades of the critical waterway, creating an uneasy standoff with no sign of peace talks on the horizon. 
US President Donald Trump on Thursday ordered the US Navy to shoot any boat putting mines in the strait, while the military said it intercepted two oil supertankers that tried to evade its effort to prevent passage to and from Iran’s ports. US forces boarded a “sanctioned stateless vessel” transporting oil from Iran in the Indian Ocean overnight, the Pentagon said. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Duckworth: Iran is Trump's 'War of Choice'

author: Salma El Wardany, Ben Bartenstein, Mirette Magdy, Patrick Sykes
description: The prospect of Iran agreeing to more in-person peace talks with the US is being hindered by President Donald Trump’s threats and brash social media posts, according to several officials with knowledge of the diplomatic efforts to end their war.
title: Trump’s Social Media Blitz Divides Advisers as Iran Talks Teeter

author: Eric Martin, Ben Bartenstein
description: President Donald Trump has repeatedly said his war against Iran is intended to prevent Tehran from ever getting a nuclear weapon. But when it comes to core nuclear issues, he risks ending up with a worse deal than the one he abandoned in his first term.
title: Trump’s Rush to End Iran War Risks Delivering Weak Nuclear Deal

author: Redd Brown
description: Though marijuana is now legal in 24 US states for recreational purposes and in 40 states for medical reasons, it’s still illegal at the federal level. But on April 23, the US Justice Department reclassified state-regulated medical marijuana as a less dangerous drug, a major shift that will dramatically reshape how cannabis companies operate in the coming years.
title: What ‘Rescheduling’ of Marijuana Means for Americans

author: Rachel Schilke, Roxana Tiron, Maeve Sheehey
description: House Republicans unveiled their latest plan to extend a US spy powers tool after a week of rebellion from privacy hawks forced leadership to settle for a 10-day extension as they worked through negotiations.
title: House GOP Leaders Unveil New Spy Powers Plan, Seek Party Unity

author: Jorge Valero
description: The European Union aims to agree on a planned reform of its flagship carbon market by early next year as part of a broader effort to speed up key changes to boost the bloc’s competitiveness.
title: EU Targets Deal on Carbon Market Overhaul in First Quarter 2027

author: Lydia Beyoud
description: The White House is reviewing new US Securities and Exchange Commission rules that would make it easier for companies to go public or raise capital by easing disclosures for new offerings and speeding up the registration process.
title: White House Reviewing SEC Bid to Ease Share-Offering Disclosures

author: Nick Wadhams
description: President Donald Trump said a visit by King Charles III to the US next week could help improve US-UK ties that have soured over Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s stance on immigration and reluctance to get involved in the Iran war.
title: Trump Tells BBC That King Charles’s Visit May Improve US-UK Ties

author: Donato Paolo Mancini, Andrea Palasciano
description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni warned that the European Union’s proposals to tackle the energy crisis caused by the war in Iran have fallen short of what’s needed.
title: Italian Premier Meloni Says EU Energy Proposals Aren’t Enough

description: President Claudia Sheinbaum said she’s waiting on US approval to name Roberto Lazzeri as Mexico’s next ambassador to Washington, as major security and trade questions hang over the crucial bilateral relationship.
title: Sheinbaum Waiting for US Green Light to Name Mexico’s New Envoy

author: Andrea Palasciano, Alberto Nardelli
description: Hungary’s incoming ruling party wants to divert €16.2 billion ($19 billion) in European Union defense loans away from companies linked to outgoing Prime Minister Viktor Orban as it seeks to speed up access to the funds.
title: Hungary Seeks to Cut Orban-Linked Firms From EU Defense Loan

author: Anthony Capaccio
description: The US Air Force plans to buy nearly 4,300 long-range stealth cruise missiles from Lockheed Martin Corp. over the next five years, according to new budget documents, after using them against Iranian targets.
title: US Air Force Plans to Boost Stockpile of Lockheed’s Stealth Missile

description: President Donald Trump and his officials tell Americans almost daily that the spike in fuel costs is a temporary blip that will reverse just as soon as he reaches a deal to end the war in Iran.

President Donald Trump ordered the US Navy to shoot any boat that are laying mines in the critical waterway, while the military said it intercepted two oil supertankers trying to evade its blockade. Tyler Kendall is covering the latest developments from Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)

description: President Donald Trump ordered the US Navy to shoot any boat putting mines in the Strait of Hormuz and vowed to step up efforts to clear the critical energy waterway amid a standoff with Iran.

description: Kenyan President William Ruto said his government and neighboring Uganda’s are in talks with Africa’s richest man, Aliko Dangote, to build a crude oil refinery in Tanzania. Sadiq Khan on 10 Years of Wins and Loses as London Mayor (Video)

description: Oil rose for a fourth day as the US and Iran remained locked in a battle for control of the Strait of Hormuz after failing to meet for a fresh round of peace talks. description: The European Union proposed “AccelerateEU” to navigate the Iran war-driven crisis, which it says it could reverberate for years.
